elevation.note: 16ppd averaged overview of NASA MOLA32ppd; numerical heights in meters above areoid.

sources.title: NASA PDS MOLA MEGDR32ppd
sources.note: NASA MGS/MOLA heights; derived normal uses physical metric slopes without exaggeration. Native bins include interpolation where observations absent.

sources.title: NASA Trek MGS MOLA Global Color Shaded Relief (463m)
sources.note: Official NASA MGS MOLA rainbow color-coded shaded relief mosaic (128 ppd, 463 m/px). Level 4 global 8K overview stored locally; native NASA WMTS endpoint streams levels 0–7.

sources.title: NASA Trek Viking VIS global color mosaic
sources.note: Native Viking MDIM21 color mosaic. Separate surface imagery layer; not merged with topography, ice or hazards. NASA WMTS level4 overview8192×4096; native endpoint supports levels0–7.

sources.title: NASA PDS MOLA128ppd complete cylindrical terrain
sources.note: All16 NASA MOLA128ppd tiles ingested losslessly into512×512 little-endian signed-meter browser tiles. Tangent-space normal maps independently derived from this elevation. Cylindrical coverage88S–88N; outer2degree caps use separately reprojected NASA512ppd polar products at128ppd output.

sources.title: NASA PDS MOLA512ppd polar topography
sources.note: Highest MOLA polar maps:12288×12288, unsigned16bit with stored*.25-8000meters. Reprojected only outer2degree caps into global128ppd output; original~115m sampling is not retained in latitude direction. North0E down/south0E up; orientation verified against overlapping128ppd observations. No voids observed in selected caps.

sources.title: NASA-cataloged CTX native tile metadata
sources.note: NASA/JPL/MSSS/Caltech Murray Lab/Esri. NASA Trek links this endpoint.512×512tiles, two columns and one row at level0. Level12 approximately5.1m/pixel; levels13–17 do not add physical source detail. NASA WMTS wrapper contains stale256pixel metadata; use native metadata.

ctxTiles.note: NASA MRO CTX beta01 uncontrolled grayscale mosaic. Native ArcGIS metadata verifies512pixel tiles; level12 matches~5m source resolution. Service levels13–17 oversample the same observations. No imagery or hazard layers blended.

polarSource.method: bilinear reprojection; quarter-meter source rounded to int16 meters
